content.title: How to watch MLB Opening Day games for free today
content.text: If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.The 2026 MLB season kicks off Wednesday night, with all 30 teams’ Opening Day coming between Wednesday and Friday. Here’s everything you need to know to watch baseball this week and for the entire season. Where can I stream the MLB Opening Day for free?The MLB Opening Day games air on NBC, MLB.TV, Netflix and each local team’s broadcast network, games also stream live on DIRECTV, which offers a five-day free trial.Sign up for DIRECTV (free trial) to watch all MLB Opening Day Games for free during your trial period (not including Netflix). FuboTV (free trial) will also air every Opening Day game, with the exception of the NBC and Netflix games. Live stream: FuboTV (free trial), DIRECTV (free trial), Peacock (for NBC games)All columns visible (no scrolling needed)What to know about MLB.TV MLB.TV allows viewers to watch every single out-of-market MLB game during the regular season. In 2026, MLB.TV is found exclusively on ESPN for the first time. If you want MLB.TV, it’ll cost $29.99 a month or $149.99 for the year. When you subscribe through ESPN, it’ll come with a free one-month subscription to ESPN Unlimited. ESPN Unlimited comes with many benefits, such as access to all ESPN cable channels, exclusive ESPN+ events such as golf, college sports and much more. At the same time, it isn’t necessary for streaming MLB games. You can cancel your ESPN Unlimited subscription after ordering your MLB.TV package to ensure that you won’t get charged after the first free month. There’s also another way to get the benefits of MLB.TV without going through ESPN. Subscriptions to either DIRECTV (free trial) or FuboTV (free trial) allow you to add MLB.TV for the same price it is on ESPN Unlimited. The benefit of subscribing through DIRECTV (free trial) or FuboTV (free trial) is that most packages come with a free ESPN Unlimited account. On top of all the benefits that comes with a DIRECTV or Fubo account, you can have MLB.TV and ESPN Unlimited for a cheaper price than if you were to buy them on their own. You won’t have to cancel an ESPN Unlimited subscription since it comes free with either streaming service. Does Netflix offer a free trial?No, there is no Netflix free trial available in 2026. The new Automated Ball-Strike Challenge System makes its official debut, giving players a limited number of challenges on called pitches. Teams keep successful challenges, meaning hitters, pitchers and catchers will all be forced to rethink how they approach tight spots. The expectation is a tighter, more objective zone, which could benefit disciplined hitters and command-first pitchers.There’s no shortage of star power on display, either. Detroit’s Tarik Skubal begins his push for a third straight Cy Young as he takes the mound in San Diego, while Paul Skenes looks to build on a dominant start to his career in his Opening Day assignment for Pittsburgh. You can also watch Four-time MVP Shohei Ohtani on NBC when the Dodgers face the Diamondbacks Thursday night. Netflix makes its MLB debut with the first game of the season on Wednesday between the Yankees and Giants. Three-time MVP Aaron Judge highlights the first game of the MLB season. Can I bet on the MLB?You can bet on the MLB from your phone in New York State, with the exception of games involving in-state teams, such as the Mets and Yankees.
